topic: An annual staff survey across nine departments
decision: which department gets a manager-support programme this quarter

columns.question: survey statement
columns.pct_favourable: percentage who agreed or strongly agreed
columns.response_rate_pct: n_responses as a percentage of headcount

findings.text: Company-wide, 66% of answers were favourable this year, against 66% last year.
Customer Support's score on 'My manager supports my growth' fell from 71% to 44% favourable, a 27-point drop and the largest change for any department on any question.
Engineering scores highest on 'I have the tools I need' (88%).
Sales has the lowest score on 'My workload is manageable' (39%), unchanged from last year.
Support's score on 'I see myself working here in two years' fell from 64% to 41%, a warning sign for staff turnover.
Understanding of company strategy rose about 9 points across departments after this year's town halls.
Finance is the smallest department, with 22 people.
Only 38% of Support staff answered this year, against 81% last year, so Support's results are less certain than other departments'.
Marketing improved most on 'I would recommend Northlight', up 8 points.
The survey ran from 8 to 22 September.

main.gist: Customer Support's scores collapsed, especially manager support and intent to stay

caveat.gist: Support's response rate fell from 81% to 38%
